name: agribalyse-3.2-copied-unit-processes
description: SimaPro names of the 'Copied from Ecoinvent' blocks of type 'Unit process' removed from the ADEME export. Names only, no exchange and no amount. Inside the Agribalyse library these unit processes draw ADEME's 'Adapted from Ecoinvent' datasets; the pipeline rebuilds them from the user's own ecoinvent snapshot so the adaptations stay connected.
